data.name: Bamboo King Vina Joint Stock Company
data.description: Bamboo King Vina is a bamboo and wood products manufacturer in Lang Chanh, Thanh Hoa province, Vietnam. It has more than 500 employees and is FSC and BSCI certified. It also turns bamboo and wood waste into biochar and says it was the first Vietnamese company recognised for biochar carbon credits.
